gloss: the company (just mentioned); the same company

definitions.gloss: the company (just mentioned); the said company
definitions.explanation: A written word that refers back to a company already named in the text, like "the company" or "the firm" in English news reporting.

examples.japanese: {同社|どうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧。
{同社|どうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The company announced a new product.

examples.japanese: A⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昨年|さくねん}→昨年：10433_sakunen⟧⟦{過去|かこ}{最高|さいこう}→過去最高：31820_kakosaikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{同社|どうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{伸|の}び{悩|なや}んでいる→伸び悩む：11457_nobinayamu⟧。
examples.english: Company A posted record profits last year, but its share price has stalled.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{同|どう}→同〜：03962_dou⟧ (the same, the aforementioned) + ⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧ (company).

USAGE:
Typical of news articles, press releases, and reports; rare in conversation, where people repeat the name or say ⟦そこ→そこ：00991_soko⟧ or ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- {同氏|どうし} (the person just mentioned)
- {同日|どうじつ} (the same day)
- ⟦{当社|とうしゃ}→当社：22449_tousha⟧ (our company)
- ⟦{御社|おんしゃ}→御社：17179_onsha⟧ (your company, in speech)
